findings.summary: Segmenter lacks the Describe supertrait of 02 4.7; ClassicSegmenter has no descriptor, so it cannot enter a Registry
SegReq has no estimated RAM, which 02 4.7 lists with CPU/GPU and max working size
ARQ-110: finite huge strokes overflow f32 inside for_covered; call returns Ok and silently drops a stroke through the image
ARQ-110 survivors: hints unchecked in zone All; alpha channel of f32 pixels unchecked
ARQ-130 size test uses default hints (zone All), skips the pipeline; a pipeline panic on 1x1 and width 2048 survives
Seed scale untested (scale=1 survives) and wrong on tall narrow images: X-axis ratio used for Y, seed misses its target
ARQ-130 Elemento: mutant keeping the largest region survives; in the test the central object is also the largest
Process breach already recorded: RED by removal on 5 SG1 tests, plus SG2 pin code written before its test; owner decides
fd_38_reduction_averages_source_blocks does not prove averaging: first-pixel sampling survives
Seed alpha criterion names no zone: it conflicts with the complement rule in Fondo and is unmet in Todo (255 under a background seed)
Spec says matting of edges; P12 has no such step and the guided filter is the only edge refinement

clip: uncut far end is a+d, not b; from beyond 1e16 an axis-parallel stroke ending in the image over-covers or leaves a gap. Finite and Ok; rated WARNING by judgement
Ramp test counts graded pixels anywhere, not in the ramp; code is right (11358 of 18900 ramp pixels graded)

Generator ranges far inside ARQ-132 (gradient dE 35+, textured 22+, area 6-19 %), so fresh 12/12 is meaningless
Hand mutants H1, H2 survive: gradients, concave shapes, holes and offsets can vanish from the gate with tests green
Hand mutant H5 survives: the area of reliable counted by alpha weight, not pixels
Hand mutant H4 survives: reliable of Background judged on the subject mask
Fresh-set count goes through eprintln, captured by cargo test; the gate log holds no such line, so ARQ-132 informs nobody
D-45 known result and parameter note do not describe the delivered code; ARQ-132 sets no range for the fresh set
Literal rule conforms, but Fondo is unreliable under a 5 % subject while Primer plano is reliable
Scene size question still open for the owner; code took the recommendation
Figures are not from D-03 hardware but the note says they hold and nothing goes to the owner
ram_bytes fits only 4000x3000: heap 96 MB at 8000x6000 against 44 MB estimated on one thread
ARQ-111 pool test and FD-38 a, b, c proofs do not name those IDs
